    Competitive Scholarships

    Academic Scholarships

    Student Recruitment and Excellence Scholarship

     

    Qatar University offers this scholarship to newly admitted, academically outstanding students residing in the State of Qatar. The scholarship is divided into two main tracks:

    • Recruitment Track:

      Designated for students wishing to enroll in specific colleges and majors, including:

      • College of Arts and Sciences (scientific majors)
      • College of Education (scientific and exact disciplines)
      • College of Nursing
      • College of Sharia and Islamic Studies
    • Excellence Track:

      Intended for academically outstanding students across all colleges of the University, including those covered under the Attraction Track. Awards are granted based on seat availability, and applicants are selected on a competitive basis.

    Program Objective

    To attract academically distinguished students to Qatar University.

    Scholarship Details

    Scholarship Program

    Targeted Category

    Benefits

    Student Recruitment and Excellence Scholarship

    Residents of Qatar for Bachelor degree
    • Exemption from tuition fees
    • Exemption from textbook fees


    Requirements for application:

    1. The applicant must have a high school certificate or its equivalent.
    2. Applicant must receive final (unconditional) admission to Qatar University.
    3. Applicant should not get benefit from this scholarship and another sponsorship/scholarship simultaneously.


    Conditions for Continuity of Scholarship:

    To maintain the scholarship, the student must comply with the following conditions:

    1. The scholarship shall be effective from the semester of award. If the student does not pass his/her first semester, the scholarship will be terminated and the student will be informed by QU email.
    2. The student must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 out of 4.0.
    3. The student must successfully complete a minimum of 12 hours per semester.
    4. The student should not exceed the period for graduation according to his/her study plan.
    5. The student must remain registered continuously (in Fall and Spring) until graduation.
    6. Recipients of the scholarship are expected to adhere to academic regulations, policies, and procedures of Qatar University.
    7. The student Must abide to the General Conditions and Special Continuity Conditions to keep the scholarship.


    Attraction Scholarship Conditions

    1. The student must continue in the same college and major for which the scholarship was awarded.
    2. In case of violation of any continuation requirement, the University reserves the right to either terminate or continue the scholarship, based on the decision of the Scholarship Committee.


    Required Documents

    Applicants for this scholarship are not required to submit any documents except the documents required for admission.


    Application and Selection Process

    1. The applicant may apply to the scholarship through the online admission application in the "Scholarship Application" section during the announced application period.
    2. Scholarship applications will be evaluated after the deadline of the online scholarship application, where applicable, the applicant's scores in standardized tests, such as IELTS or TOEFL, as well as SAT, ACT, or QU Math Placer, may be considered, in addition to any other criteria deemed appropriate by the Scholarship Committee.
    3. Admission and scholarship decisions will be announced via email according to the announced timeline.



    International Students Scholarship

    Qatar University offers this scholarship to international students who apply to undergraduate programs ( Students who transfer from other universities to Qatar University, visiting students, non-degree applicants and applicants seeking a second bachelor's degree are not eligible for academic scholarships offered by Qatar University).

    The applicant is requested to apply to this scholarship during the announced application period. Applicants for this scholarship are selected on a competitive basis.


    Scholarship Objective

    Recruiting international students of outstanding academic performance.

    Scholarship Details

    Scholarship Program

    Targeted Category

    Benefits

    International Students Scholarship

    International students who apply for undergraduate programs.

    • Exemption from tuition fees
    • Exemption from textbook fees
    • 500 QR monthly salary
    • Student housing (two students per room) including transportation to/from campus.
    • Annual round trip air fare ticket
    • Residence permit under QU sponsorship


    Requirements for application:

    1. The applicant must have a high school certificate or its equivalent.
    2. A minimum high school average of 95%.
    3. Applicant must receive the final acceptance in the university.
    4. The applicant must meet the admission requirements for the college that they applied to.
    5. The scholarship should be utilized starting from the semester in which the scholarship was awarded. The start of the study can be postponed for one semester, if necessary, conditional of approval of the scholarship committee. If the student does not pass his/her first semester, the scholarship will be canceled and the student will be informed by QU email.
    6. Applicant should not get benefit from this scholarship and another sponsorship/scholarship simultaneously.

    Conditions for Continuity of Scholarship:
    1. The student must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 out of 4.0.
    2. The student must successfully complete a minimum of 12 hours per semester.
    3. The student must remain registered continuously (in Fall and Spring) until graduation.
    4. The student should not exceed the period for graduation according to his/her study plan.
    5. Recipients of the scholarship are expected to adhere to academic regulations, policies, and procedures of Qatar University.
    6. Must abide to the General Conditions to keep the scholarship.

    Upon receiving the applications, the scholarship committee may consider the applicant’s standard test scores in English (IELTS or TOEFL) and in Mathematics (SAT, ACT, QU Math Placer) or other test scores selected by the committee. 


    Required Documents

    Applicants for this scholarship are not required to submit any documents except the documents required for admission.


    How to Apply

    International students applicants may apply to this scholarship through the online admission application in the “Scholarship Application” section during the announced application period.
    International students must submit the original high school transcript and required documents during the application period for international students to Qatar University to the following address:

    Admissions Department
    Qatar University
    P.O. Box 2713
    Doha, Qatar


    Application and evaluation procedures:

    1. Students apply for admission and scholarships online using the online admission application during the announced application period.
    2. The applicants will be evaluated after the deadline of the online scholarship application. An initial conditional acceptance letter will be sent to the nominated students.
    3. After receiving admission decision in the university, the university will apply for visas and the students will be notified accordingly.
    4. The final admission and scholarship decisions will be sent to the students by email according to the announced  timeline.

    H.H. the Emir of Qatar's Scholarship for Academic Excellence

     

    Qatar University offers this scholarship to students of outstanding performance in the Qatari Secondary Education Certificate who wish to join an undergraduate major at Qatar University.


    Scholarship Objective

    Recruiting students of outstanding Qatari Secondary Education Certificate performance.


    Scholarship Details

    The student must apply for the Admission Scholarship only, and the top achievers are selected for this scholarship on a competitive basis.

    Scholarship Program

    Targeted Category

    Benefits

    H.H. the Emir of Qatar's Scholarship for Academic Excellence

    Students of outstanding performance in the Qatari Secondary Education Certificate for Bachelor degree

    • Exemption from tuition fees
    • Exemption from textbook fees
    • Monthly salary of 1,000 QR for 9 months per academic year


    Requirements for application:

    1. The applicant must hold a Qatari Secondary Education Certificate.
    2. A minimum average of 95% in the secondary school certificate.
    3. The applicant should be a secondary school graduate in the same year in which the scholarship application is made.
    4. These scholarship awards are only made in the Fall semester.
    5. The scholarship should be utilized starting from the semester in which the scholarship was awarded. If the student does not pass his/her first semester, the scholarship will be terminated and the student will be informed by QU email.
    6. Applicant should not get benefit from this scholarship and another sponsorship/scholarship simultaneously.


    Conditions for Continuity of Scholarship:

    1. The student must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 out of 4.0.
    2. The student must successfully complete a minimum of 12 hours per semester.
    3. The student should not exceed the period for graduation according to his/her study plan.
    4. The student must remain registered continuously (in Fall and Spring) until graduation.
    5. Recipients of the scholarship are expected to adhere to academic regulations, policies, and procedures of Qatar University.
    6. Must abide to the General Conditions to keep the scholarship.


    Required Documents

    Applicants for this scholarship are not required to submit any documents except the documents required for admission.


    How to Apply

    Applicants may apply for the Admission Scholarship only, and the top achievers are selected for this scholarship. They can apply through the online admission application in the “Scholarship Application” section during the announced application period.


    Application and evaluation procedures:

    1. Students apply for admission and scholarship online using the online admission application during the announced application period.
    2. The applicants will be evaluated after the deadline of the online scholarship application.
    3. The applicants will be contacted (as needed) to provide documents required for obtaining the scholarship.
    4. The final admission and scholarship decisions will be sent to the students by email according to the announced  timeline.

    Outstanding Performance Scholarship

    Qatar University offers this scholarship to academically distinguished students enrolled in the undergraduate level in QU. Applicants for this scholarship are selected on a competitive basis.


    Scholarship Objective

    Retaining academically distinguished students at Qatar University.


    Scholarship Details

    Scholarship Program

    Targeted Category

    Benefits

    Outstanding Performance Scholarship

    Students enrolled at QU for Bachelor degree

    		Exemption from tuition fees.


    Requirements for application:

    1. Applicant must be enrolled at Qatar University.
    2. Must have a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.50 out of 4.00.
    3. Must have completed at least 30 credit hours in QU.
    4. Applicant cannot benefit from this scholarship and another sponsorship/scholarship simultaneously.


    Conditions for Continuity of Scholarship:

    1. The student must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 out of 4.0.
    2. The student must successfully complete a minimum of 12 hours per semester.
    3. The student should not exceed the period for graduation according to his/her study plan.
    4. The student must remain registered continuously (in Fall and Spring) until graduation.
    5. Recipients of the scholarship are expected to adhere to academic regulations, policies, and procedures of Qatar University.
    6. Must abide to the General Conditions to keep the scholarship.


    Required Documents

    Applicants for this scholarship are not required to submit any documents.


    How to Apply

    Current students at Qatar University may apply online through myBanner Self-Service System during the announced application period.  Please view the applicant manual for this scholarship.

     

    GCC States Scholarships (Embassies)

    Qatar University offers this scholarship to academically distinguished students of Gulf Cooperation Council states (GCC) who hold the High School Certificate or its equivalent from their countries or any other country but not from Qatar and are seeking to join an undergraduate program at Qatar University. The student must submit their application for admission to the undergraduate program at Qatar University in person. A number of scholarships are allocated to each GCC state and nominating candidates to these scholarships is left to GCC embassies. Such scholarships can be postponed to the second term in the same academic year but not to the next academic year.


    Scholarship Objective

    Attracting distinguished students from the GCC states to Qatar University.


    Scholarship Details

    Scholarship Program

    Targeted Category

    Benefits

    GCC States Scholarship

    Students from GSS states for Bachelor degree

    • Exemption from tuition fees.
    • Student housing (two students per room) including transportation to/from campus.


    Requirements for application:

    1. The applicant must have a high school certificate or its equivalent.
    2. The applicant must meet the admission requirements for the college that they applied to.
    3. Obtain a letter from the embassy addressed to Qatar University requesting consideration for this specific scholarship.
    4. Applicant cannot benefit from this scholarship and another sponsorship/scholarship simultaneously.


    Conditions for Continuity of Scholarship:

    1. The student must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 out of 4.0.
    2. The student must successfully complete a minimum of 12 hours per semester.
    3. The student should not exceed the period for graduation according to his/her study plan.
    4. The student must remain registered continuously (in Fall and Spring) until graduation.
    5. Recipients of the scholarship are expected to adhere to academic regulations, policies, and procedures of Qatar University.
    6. Must abide to the General Conditions to keep the scholarship.


    Application and evaluation procedures:

    1. The students may apply through the online admission application during the announced application period.
    2. Students should apply for scholarship nomination through the embassy of his/her country in Qatar after receiving the final admission decision at Qatar University. The nomination letters must be submitted directly to Qatar University.
    3. The embassies’ nominations will be evaluated after the deadline of the scholarship application.
    4. The final admission and scholarship decisions will be sent to the students by email according to the announced scholarship timeline. The embassies will be notified.

    Talent Scholarship

    Talent Scholarship Requirements and how to apply

     

    Qatar University offers this scholarship to undergraduate non-Qatari students (including international students) who are talented in the fields of scientific research, technology and innovation, literature, acting for male, media, and athleticism. Applicants for this scholarship are selected on a competitive basis.


    Scholarship Objective

    Recruiting talented students in the fields of scientific research, technology and innovation, literature, acting for male, media, and athleticism.


    Scholarship Details

    Scholarship Program

    Targeted Category

    Benefits

    Talent Scholarship

    Talented students for Bachelor degree

    • Exemption from tuition fees
    • Exemption from textbook fees
    • Monthly salary of 1,000 QR
    • Guarantee to be admitted to the desired program of study upon meeting the minimum program admission requirements (except for medicine and dental medicine)
    • For international talented students: Student housing (two students per room) including transportation to/from campus, annual round trip air fare ticket and residence permit under QU sponsorship.


    Requirements for application:

    1. The applicant must have a high school certificate or its equivalent.
    2. A minimum high school average of 80%.
    3. Applicant must meet the minimum admissions requirements of the program that he/she wishes to join.
    4. Applicant must submit the final transcript of the 11th  grade with a minimum average of 80%.
    5. Applicant must submit the final transcript of the first semester of the 12th grade with a minimum average of 80%.
    6. Applicant must provide a minimum of two letters of recommendation to support the application from prestigious entities relevant to the area of talent.
    7. Applicant must submit a portfolio letter presenting his/her talent and proving the recent achievements in the field of talent, specifically in one of the following areas: scientific research (includes all literary and scientific fields), technology and innovation, literature, acting for male, media, and athleticism.
    8. Applicant should pass the personal interview with the committee.  
    9. Applicants cannot benefit from this scholarship and another scholarship simultaneously, except for international students (terms and conditions apply).
    10. Applicants who have previously granted the full benefits of this scholarship are not eligible to benefit from it again for the purpose of acquiring a new academic degree.
    11. The scholarship should be utilized starting from the semester in which the scholarship was awarded. For international students, the start of the study can be postponed for one semester, if necessary, conditional of approval of the scholarship committee. If the student does not pass his/her first semester, the scholarship will be canceled and the student will be informed by QU email.


    Sport Talent


    MalesFemales
    Swimming-
    Football

    		 Football

    Volleyball
    		 Volleyball
    Basketball Basketball
    Padel
    		Padel
    Table Tennis

    		Table Tennis



    Conditions for Continuity of Scholarship:

    1. The student must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.5/4.0.
    2. The student must successfully complete a minimum of 12 hours per semester.
    3. The student must regularly represent the university in the area of talent locally and internationally.
    4. The student should not exceed the period for graduation according to his/her program.
    5. The student must remain registered continuously (in Fall and Spring) until graduation.
    6. The student must commit to the continuous practice and development of the talent.
    7. Recipients of the scholarship are expected to adhere to academic regulations, policies, and procedures of Qatar University.
    8. Must abide by the General Conditions to keep the scholarship.


    Required Documents:

    1. Applicant must provide a minimum of two letters of recommendation to support the application from prestigious entities relevant to the area of talent.
    2. Applicant must submit a portfolio letter with a link to a video of large-size file supporting files (e.g. on Dropbox or OneDrive) presenting his/her talent and proving the recent achievements in the field of talent, specifically in one of the following areas: scientific research (includes all literary and scientific fields), technology and innovation, literature, acting for male, media, and athleticism. For athletic talent, the video must show the applicant playing within a team during a match.
    3. After passing the personal interview successfully, Applicants for the field of sport talent are required to submit signed history and medical information form along with the physical examination form filled by a health care provider (family doctor or general practitioner) and to pass a physical fitness examination at Qatar University.


    How to Apply

    The applicant may apply to the talent scholarship through the online admission application on “Scholarship Application” page during the announced application period. The applicant is requested to upload the required and supporting documents presenting his/her talent and achievements.


    Application and evaluation procedures:

    1. Students apply for admission and for scholarship online using the online admission application during the announced application period.
    2. Students enrolled in schools outside Qatar or in private schools inside Qatar (non-governmental Qatari school system) must upload the first semester certificate of grade twelve and the final certificate of grade eleven. If the student completed grade twelve, he/she must submit only the final certificate of grade twelve.
    3. Applicant must upload a minimum of two recommendation letters through the online admission application from recognized entities relevant to the area of talent to support the application.
    4. Applicant must submit a letter summarizing his/her talent, achievements, and awards received with a link to large-size files including videos and any other supporting documents (e.g. on Dropbox or OneDrive) to highlight his/her talent and to show the recent achievements in one field of the following talents: scientific research (includes all art and scientific fields), technology, innovation, literature, acting for male, media, and sports.
    5. The applicants' files will be evaluated and interviews will be conducted to assess the eligibility and qualifications of the applicant.  The best applicants for each talent field will be short-listed.
    6. An initial conditional acceptance letter will be sent to the nominated students, within six weeks after the deadline of the online scholarship application, stating the conditions that must be met and the documents required to receive the final acceptance.
    7. For international students, after they send the required documents, the university will apply for their visas and they will be notified accordingly.
    8. The final admission and scholarship decisions will be sent to students by email according to the announced timeline.

     


    Non-Competitive Scholarships

    GCC Qatari Certificate Scholarships

    These scholarships are offered by the University to GCC students who hold the Qatari High School Certificate.


    Scholarship Objective

    Attracting students from the GCC states that hold Qatari high school certificate to Qatar University.


    Scholarship Details

    Scholarship Program

    Targeted Category

    Benefits

    GCC Qatari Certificate Scholarships

    GCC students with Qatari certificate for Bachelor degree

    		Exemption from tuition fees.


    Requirements for application:

    1. The applicant must have a Qatari Secondary Education certificate.
    2. The applicant must meet the admission requirements for the college that they applied to.
    3. Applicant cannot benefit from this scholarship and another sponsorship/scholarship simultaneously.


    Conditions for Continuity of Scholarship:

    1. The student should not exceed the period for graduation according to his/her study plan.
    2. The student must remain registered continuously in all semesters (Fall and Spring).
    3. Recipients of scholarship are expected to adhere to academic regulations, policies, and procedures of Qatar University.
    4. This scholarship covers all terms, fall, spring and summer/winter; however, the summer/winter terms would not be counted from the scholarship terms.
    5. The student is responsible to pay the penalty or fine when withdrawing from courses or semester.


    Required Documents

    Applicants for this scholarship are not required to submit any documents except the documents required for admission.


    How to Apply

    The applicant may apply to this scholarship through the online admission application on “Scholarship Application” page during the announced application period.


    Application and evaluation procedures:

    1. Students apply for admission and scholarship online using the online admission application during the announced application period.
    2. The applicants will be evaluated after the deadline of the online scholarship application.
    3. The final admission and scholarship decisions will be sent to the students by email according to the announced  timeline.

    Children of Qatar University Employees Scholarship

    Qatar University offers this scholarship to the children of Qatar University employees. The University offers a maximum of three scholarships to three children of the employee simultaneously.


    Scholarship Objective

    Supporting and retaining Qatar University employees.


    Scholarship Details

    Scholarship Program

    Targeted Category

    Benefits

    Children of Qatar University Employees Scholarship

    Children of Qatar University Employees for Bachelor degree

    		Exemption from tuition fees


    Requirements for application:

    1. The applicant must have a high school certificate or its equivalent.
    2. The applicant must meet the admission requirements for the college that they applied to.
    3. The parent(s) of the applicant must be a full-time employee at QU.
    4. Applicant cannot benefit from this scholarship and another sponsorship/scholarship simultaneously.


    Conditions for Continuity of Scholarship:

    1. The student should not exceed the period for graduation according to his/her study plan.
    2. The student must remain registered continuously in all semesters (Fall and Spring).
    3. Recipients of scholarship are expected to adhere to academic regulations, policies, and procedures of Qatar University.
    4. This scholarship covers all terms, fall, spring and summer/winter; however, the summer/winter terms would not be counted from the scholarship terms.
    5. The student is responsible to pay the penalty or fine when withdrawing from courses or semester.


    How to Apply

    The applicant may apply to this scholarship through the online admission application on “Scholarship Application” page during the announced application period. The student is required to upload the following documents in PDF format:

    • Copy of the applicant’s birth certificate.
    • Copy of the parent’s Qatar ID card.


    Application and evaluation procedures:

    1. Students apply for admission and scholarship online using the online admission application during the announced application period.
    2. The applicants will be evaluated after the deadline of the online scholarship application.
    3. The applicants will be contacted (as needed) to provide documents required for obtaining the scholarship.
    4. The final admission and scholarship decisions will be sent to the students by email according to the announced  timeline.


    Other types of scholarships

    Short Scholarships for the Arabic Program for Non-Native Program

    This scholarship is designed to learn Arabic for non-native speakers students from outside Qatar. The admission process to this scholarship is handling by the Scholarships and International Admissions Section in coordinating with the Arabic for Non-Native Speakers Program. The student can be nominated by one of the organizations which have an established agreement with Qatar University and admitted by the President of Qatar University to grant scholarship on annual basis. The program duration is one academic year.

    In order to know how to apply to this scholarship please visit the following page: Arabic for Non-native Speakers Program.

    College of Education Diploma Scholarships

    Qatar University offers a number of scholarships for students who want to join the diploma programs offered by the College of Education.

    Benefits

    These scholarships include exemption from tuition fees only.

    Requirements for application:

    1. The applicant must meet the admission requirements for the college that they applied to.

    2. The applicant must be working under the ministry of education and higher education or any governmental educational organization.

    3. It should be the first time for the applicant to apply for a scholarship in the same category offered by the College of Education.

     

    Conditions for Continuity of Scholarship:

    1. The student must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.50 out of 4 at the end of each semester.
    2. The duration of studying shouldn't exceed two semesters excluding the semesters of absence and withdrawal.
    3. The student should not be absent or withdraw for two separated or consecutive semesters.
    4. If the student fails in meeting any of the conditions to maintain the scholarship, it will be canceled and the student will have to pay the tuition fees of the following semesters.
    5. After the student's scholarship has been canceled, he/she will not be eligible to receive that scholarship again, regardless of whether the situation is amended. In all cases, the academic policies will be applied to the student as shown in the Student Catalog.

    Required Documents:

    1. "To whom it may concern" Letter for the new academic year proofing that the applicant is working under the ministry of education and higher education or any governmental educational organization.
    2. Copy of ID card or passport (identification card).
